# Karahan Era

> Interactive world history timeline and atlas from 500,000 BCE to today. Drag the timeline and the world map shows coastlines, ice sheets, vegetation, cultures, states, migrations, radiocarbon-dated sites and population for that year, with dated events for six world regions, each linked to Wikipedia. Free, open source (MIT), data from cited scientific datasets.

The calendar counts from Year 1 KE (Karahan Era) = 9500 BCE. Figures before 1800 are scholarly estimates; contested points are flagged on the page.

## Use

- [The atlas](https://kmdan.github.io/historytimeline/karahan-era.html): the interactive page (needs JavaScript; map drawn with WebGL2, CPU fallback).
- Deep links: `karahan-era.html?y=-4500` opens the world in 4500 BCE (signed civil year, negative = BCE, no year 0, range -500000 to 2026). Add `&at=lat,lon,zoom` for a map view, e.g. `?y=1750&at=48,10,4` (zoom 1 = whole world).
- The page text (lead, field report, "About the data") is plain HTML; the map and timeline are canvas drawings.

## Data

- [README with sources and licences](https://github.com/kmdan/historytimeline#readme)
- [Source code](https://github.com/kmdan/historytimeline) (MIT); data keeps its source licences (mostly CC BY 4.0).
- `atlas/cp/index.json` and `atlas/cp/<century>.json`: states from 3400 BCE (Cliopatria v0.2.1, Seshat, CC BY 4.0), one file per century; each state has name, Wikipedia title, from/to years and compact integer outlines.
- `atlas/hb/*.json`: peoples and earlier borders (historical-basemaps).
- `atlas/c14.json`: ~200,000 radiocarbon dates binned by time and grid cell (p3k14c, XRONOS; calibrated with IntCal20).
- `atlas/coast.json` (Natural Earth 50m) and `atlas/rivers.json`: today's coastline and rivers, compact integer coordinates.
- PNG rasters (`slw.png`, `ice.png`, `biome_beyer.png`, `popd.png`, `terrain.png`) encode coastlines, ice, biomes, population and elevation; encodings are documented in `dev/HANDOFF.md`.

## Main sources

- Coastlines, last 26,000 years: De Groeve et al. 2022, https://doi.org/10.1111/geb.13573
- Ice sheets: PaleoMIST 1.0, Gowan et al. 2021, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-021-21469-w
- Biomes and local temperature: Beyer, Krapp & Manica 2020, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0552-1
- Global temperature: Osman et al. 2021; Kaufman et al. 2020
- States: Cliopatria, Bennett et al. 2025, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04516-9
- Population: HYDE 3.2.1, Klein Goldewijk et al. 2017, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-9-927-2017
- Volcanic eruptions: eVolv2k v4, Sigl & Toohey 2024, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.971968
